diagrams.title: HTTP request lifecycle
diagrams.caption: HTTP request lifecycle with all error paths
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant C as Client participant MW as Backend middlewares participant AH as ActionHandler participant RH as RequestHandler participant AI as ActionInvoker participant S as Action method C->>MW: GET /typo3/api/v1/my-extension/page/42/titles alt backend session cookie Note over MW: Backend authentication
scopes: all allowed for the user else no cookie (EXT:hub) Note over MW: Validate app token
scopes: those of the token end MW->>AH: handle(request) alt no valid token AH-->>C: 401 problem+json, WWW-Authenticate Bearer end AH->>RH: handle(request) alt required scope not granted RH-->>C: 403 Missing scope, insufficient_scope end alt invalid or missing argument RH-->>C: 400 problem+json with all invalid parameters end RH->>AI: invoke(action, arguments, context) AI->>S: titles(uid: 42, context) alt declared error S-->>RH: NotFoundError RH-->>C: 404 problem+json, type from the exception code end S-->>AI: result alt result does not match the output schema AI-->>C: 500 problem+json with the request ID end AI-->>RH: validated result RH-->>C: 200 JSON (201 with Location for a created resource, 204 if empty)

diagrams.title: MCP tool calls
diagrams.caption: An MCP tool call inside the action mcp
diagrams.intro: The MCP server is the action `mcp` (`POST /typo3/api/mcp`, scope `mcp`). TYPO3 authenticates, checks the scopes and validates a call to the action `mcp` like any other call. The action `mcp` then calls the requested tool through the same `ActionInvoker`.
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant A as AI client participant H as EXT:hub participant API as Action API participant M as Action mcp participant I as ActionInvoker participant D as Action dashboards A->>H: POST /typo3/api/mcp (tools/call fetch_dashboards) Note over H: Validate OAuth token
user + granted scopes H->>API: request Note over API: Scope mcp granted API->>I: invoke mcp I->>M: JSON-RPC message Note over M: Tool only available if
dashboard:read is granted M->>I: invoke dashboards I->>D: call method as the user D-->>I: result I-->>M: validated result M-->>API: JSON-RPC result API-->>A: 200 structuredContent

status_codes.cause: Success, or `204` if the action returns nothing
A `create` action with a declared link created a resource. The header `Location` holds the URL of the new resource.
A missing argument, invalid JSON or a value that does not match the input schema. The member `errors` lists all invalid parameters.
No valid access token. The header `WWW-Authenticate` contains `Bearer`, with `error="invalid_token"` if the request contained a token.

The token lacks a scope of the action, the data needs a scope that the token lacks (`InsufficientScopeError`), or the action throws `PermissionDeniedError`. For a missing scope, the header `WWW-Authenticate` names the scope with `error="insufficient_scope"`.
The action throws `NotFoundError`, the route is unknown, or the action has no target for the channel of the caller
The result does not match the output schema, or the action fails with an unexpected error. The response contains the request ID of the log entry, but no internal details.

errors.title: Error responses
errors.intro: Every error of the HTTP API is a problem details object of RFC 9457 with the content type `application/problem+json`. The OAuth endpoints of EXT:hub keep the error format of RFC 6749.

fields.text: The URL of the exception code in the exception reference of TYPO3, for example `https://typo3.org/go/exception/CMS/1791975434`. For an error without an exception code, for example a missing scope or an unknown route, and for `500`, the value is `about:blank`.
The reason phrase of the status code, for example `Not Found`.
For `400`, a list of all invalid parameters. Each entry has a `detail` and a `pointer` into the request body, for example `#/record/title`, or the name of the query or path parameter in `parameter`.
For `500`, the ID of the request in the log. The response contains no internal details, also not for a PHP error of the action.

errors.note: The exception code of a declared error is part of the API, also in an extension, because the code sets the `type`. OpenAPI documents every declared error and a `default` response with the schema `ProblemDetails`.

mcp.behaviour: All actions with the target `ai` whose scopes the token grants. The action `mcp` has only the targets `backend` and `http`, so the tool list does not show the action `mcp`.
The identifier of the action, for example `fetch_dashboards` or `fetch_dashboard_widget`
`structuredContent`. TYPO3 wraps a result that is not an object as `{"data": …}`.

The JSON-RPC error “invalid params” (`-32602`) for invalid arguments, an unknown tool or a tool with a missing scope. The JSON-RPC error “internal error” (`-32603`) for a result that does not match the output schema, and for an unexpected error of the action with the request ID of the log entry instead of the message. A tool result with `isError` and the message for a declared error of the action, for example `NotFoundError`.
